entities.name: Pre-Occupation Political Crisis
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Between 1911 and 1915, Haiti had six presidents in rapid succession — several killed or overthrown. President Vilbrun Guillaume Sam was lynched by a mob in July 1915, providing the pretext for U.S. intervention.
